_doc: Sponsored Founder Studio company for Caroline Schirato (INMA), tuned for event planning + sponsorship development. Doubles as Code's provisioning fixture for pipeline M1 (provision) and M3 (billing + sponsorship). Field shapes match start-studio.html handoff payload + gift-method-spec sponsorship flags. All staff editable; additions stay in-kind.

account.owner_title: Mayor of Angels Camp, California; Events Director, InfraGard National Members Alliance (INMA)
account.owner_context: Unanimously appointed Mayor of Angels Camp by the City Council on January 6, 2026; previously City Council member and Vice Mayor. Angels Camp is a small Calaveras County city with a heavy tourism-events calendar.

sponsorship.sponsor: Dr. Terry L. Oroszi / Emerging Technologies Laboratory
sponsorship._statement_note: Per Dr. O 2026-06-25: Caroline should not be made to credit the sponsor. The owner-facing banner shows the tier and $0 due only, no 'Sponsored by Dr. Oroszi' line. The sponsor field above stays for internal accounting; it is not rendered to Caroline.
sponsorship.staff_limit_note: No cap. Caroline can hire as many staff as she wants; every addition is sponsored and stays in-kind at $0 due. The starter team below is a starting point, not a ceiling.

pa.note: Her pick. Swappable to any pool persona later if she wants.

video_calls.note: Auggie has a real voice and can talk with Caroline out loud and join her on Zoom (or Meet/Teams) to brief her, take direction live, and take notes. Standard PA capability.

company.beat: Mayor of Angels Camp (constituent communications, council meeting prep, proclamations and remarks, city grant-seeking, local/tourism events) and Events Director for INMA (event planning plus sponsorship development with a dedicated closer).

staff.name: Benjamin Reed

free_assistant.note: A board hire comes with one free assistant. The owner (Caroline) picks it from the 10-PA pool at hire time, same picker as choosing a PA. Persona only, no backpack. She can also skip it.

staff.why: Anchor of the gift. CISO and InfraGard member; the agent Dr. O described to the INMA board. The security authority that makes events and sponsor pitches credible.

staff.name: Delia Marsh
staff.why: Dedicated sponsorship closer, built on request. Backpack pulls live capacity signals (SEC EDGAR, SAM.gov, USAspending, ProPublica 990s) to rank prospects and size the ask. Runs the full development pipeline; Caroline keeps the relationship and makes the close. For the mayor role she also chases municipal grants (federal and state) using the same backpack (SAM.gov, USAspending, and public funding signals).

staff.name: Reid Callum
staff.why: Builds the sponsor pitch and runs event promotion, now with a live marketing-landscape backpack. Double duty across both of her jobs.

staff.name: Ayanna Cole
staff.why: Event comms, speaker coordination, and sponsor-facing outreach.

staff.name: Grey Hollis
staff.why: Mayoral fit: speeches, proclamations, council remarks, op-eds, and event remarks. A mayor lives on prepared words.

staff.name: The Professor
staff.why: Fact-checks claims before public statements, summarizes staff reports and ordinances in plain language, and vets sponsor and event facts. Serves all three roles: mayor, events director, and sponsorship.

sixpack_members.name: Yuki Mendel
sixpack_members.note: event collateral, sponsor decks, signage. Top fit.

sixpack_members.name: Alicia James
sixpack_members.note: bonus; low relevance for a nonprofit

gaps_flagged: RESOLVED: dedicated sponsorship closer added (Margo Whitfield, MCP backpack, $25/mo). She runs the full pipeline; the relationship and close stay with Caroline.
Optional add for sponsorship and event-ops strategy at board level: Raymond Chen (Judge, Business & Operations), +$45/mo, includes a free assistant.

Swapped out: Alistair Montgomery (Strategy & Market Analyst). Margo's backpack covers prospect research directly, so the generic analyst was redundant for this team. Add Alistair back at $25/mo if market-sizing depth is wanted.

value_breakdown.includes: PA + Studio (Auggie, with backpack, voice, and Zoom), the Essential Six-Pack, a full custom bench (CISO board advisor, development and sponsorship closer, marketing, communications, ghostwriter, fact-checker), custom integrations, concierge onboarding 1:1 with Dr. O, and weekly output review.
value_breakdown.valuation_note: Valued at the Executive tier retail price ($1,499/mo), which is the package she receives. The same staff itemized a la carte is about $733/mo; the Executive tier adds concierge onboarding with Dr. O, custom integrations, full-bench access, and weekly review beyond raw headcount. If a conservative in-kind number is preferred for the city's or nonprofit's books, the itemized $732.99 can be used instead.

_backpack_summary: Backpack (live tools): Auggie (PA), Benjamin Reed (CISO), Delia Marsh (Dev/Sponsorships + municipal grants), Reid Callum (standing; live marketing-landscape backpack + slick generator), Leo Vance (six-pack). In-framework only: Ayanna Cole, Grey Hollis, The Professor, Alicia James, Kimberly Pass, Sasha Moreno, Yuki Mendel. Benjamin's free assistant carries NO backpack. Reid appears once (standing); the six-pack is Yuki, Leo, Sasha, Kimberly, Alicia. Rowan is no longer on this roster (he became the separately-sold C-Suite MCP execution specialist).

studio_landing.purpose: Caroline opens her magic link and lands directly in her Studio, fully staffed. No marketing, no pricing, no checkout.
show_on_first_login: In-kind banner (no sponsor credit, per Dr. O 2026-06-25): 'Executive tier. $1,499/mo value, $0 due.'
Studio header showing the company name (editable; see rename)
Her PA, Auggie, present with voice and Zoom available
All 14 staff populated on the Staff board and active in The Floor
The live panels: morning brief, chat window, On the Floor right now, Recently shipped, Command the staff
An optional first-run nudge to name her company and PA; defaults work if she skips
studio_landing.rename: She can rename the Studio (to her office, the city, or INMA) and rename her PA anytime. Persist company_name and pa.display_name.
studio_landing.no_payment_ui: Do not show pricing, a card field, or a checkout anywhere in her account. amount_due_monthly is 0.
needs_from_dr_o: Confirm the default company_name (currently 'INMA Events Studio'); she can rename after login
